mapper.select: SELECT statistics_snapshot_id FROM statistics_snapshot WHERE sync_job_id = #{syncJobId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY statistics_snapshot_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO statistics_snapshot ( statistics_snapshot_id, sync_job_id, as_of_date, scope_type, warehouse_id, sales_point_id, scope_code, scope_name, payload_version, payload_json, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{snapshotId}, #{syncJobId}, #{asOfDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{aggregate.scopeType}, #{aggregate.warehouseId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{aggregate.salesPointId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{aggregate.scopeCode}, #{aggregate.scopeName}, #{payloadVersion}, #{payloadJson,jdbcType=CLOB}, (SELECT user_id FROM app_user WHERE login_id = '__system__' AND is_deleted = 0), (SELECT user_id FROM app_user WHERE login_id = '__system__' AND is_deleted = 0) )
mapper.sql: s.statistics_snapshot_id, s.sync_job_id, s.as_of_date, s.scope_type, s.warehouse_id, s.sales_point_id, s.scope_code, s.scope_name, COALESCE(w.region_code, sp.region_code) AS region_code, s.payload_version, s.payload_json, s.created_at, s.updated_at, s.created_by, s.updated_by, s.is_deleted
mapper.select:
WITH latest_group AS ( SELECT sync_job_id FROM statistics_snapshot WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND scope_type = 'NATIONAL' AND scope_code = 'ALL'
AND as_of_date <= TRUNC(#{toDate,jdbcType=DATE})
ORDER BY as_of_date DESC, created_at DESC, statistics_snapshot_id DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ) SELECT FROM statistics_snapshot s JOIN latest_group latest ON latest.sync_job_id = s.sync_job_id LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN sales_point sp ON sp.sales_point_id = s.sales_point_id WHERE s.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY CASE s.scope_type WHEN 'NATIONAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'WAREHOUSE' THEN 2 WHEN 'OFFLINE_STORE' THEN 3 WHEN 'ONLINE_STORE' THEN 4 WHEN 'UNASSIGNED' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END, CASE WHEN s.scope_code = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, s.scope_name, s.statistics_snapshot_id

SELECT statistics_snapshot_id, sync_job_id, as_of_date, scope_type, warehouse_id, sales_point_id, scope_code, scope_name, payload_version, payload_json, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted FROM ( SELECT s.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY s.as_of_date ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.statistics_snapshot_id DESC ) AS row_no FROM statistics_snapshot s WHERE s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.scope_type = #{scopeType} AND s.scope_code = #{scopeCode} AND s.as_of_date BETWEEN TRUNC(#{fromDate,jdbcType=DATE}) AND TRUNC(#{toDate,jdbcType=DATE}) ) WHERE row_no = 1 ORDER BY as_of_date, created_at, statistics_snapshot_id
